prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 2D side-scrolling action adventure GAMEPLAY DESIGN PLATE, Whale Fall: Echoes of the Tide V4.3. Reference image is ONLY our owned Tidekeeper identity. Preserve exactly one circular DARK LENS in a round ivory diving helmet, short petrol-teal cape, charcoal limbs, broad webbed feet, ONE sealed amber lamp at LEFT hip, coral-red tether and U-shaped TWO-prong resonance tool (never a blade). Three-head-tall proportions; do not turn hero into white mask knight. Art direction: confident clean near-black ink contours, two or three broad flat painted values, very sparse texture, strongly readable silhouette, dark foreground framing, clear playable middle plane, low-contrast atmospheric backgrounds. Poetic underwater ruins of a DEAD whale, tiny shell shelters and red repair knots, no human architecture. A strong action-adventure visual explanation, NOT just a pretty landscape. Landscape canvas about 16:9, high resolution. Panels must be distinct and strictly regular, correct left-to-right top-to-bottom numbering. Only requested numbered labels; no wordy text, no title, no copied HUD. Every action pose retains hero identity. Effects small enough to see enemy and weapon; bone fork always visibly has two prongs. Avoid Horned white knight, paired black eye mask, insect kingdom, nail weapon, stag station, gothic city, crowns, human warriors, recognizable Hollow Knight characters/enemies/bosses/maps/UI/logos. No naked flame, no whale revival, no gore. Treat the style as general hand-inked atmospheric action art, never trace a specific existing game composition. Layout: EXACTLY 6 panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid, all the same size. Thin plain gutters. Each panel 01-06 has sufficient space for visible characters, floor and safe path. Six numbered successive gameplay storyboard panels 01-06. SAME continuous local level across all frames, camera shifts only as hero progresses. Palette inky navy, slate blue, small amber lamps. the mouth of a dead baleen whale; baleen ONLY from upper jaw, broad smooth tongue terraces and empty shell shelters; NO gothic arches or human masonry. 01 hero observes crab raising one asymmetrical claw from outside reach. 02 hero retreats half a body length as the claw sweeps empty ground. 03 hero steps in and hits exposed flank with U-fork. 04 hero chooses an ordinary jump to a higher tongue shelf, second crab remains below. 05 hero pulls red-rope latch from far side, thin curtain parts. 06 hero stands at opened shortcut looking back to recognizable starting shell, sealed amber sample at feet. Hero is small, full body, every frame shows what it is doing and what platform supports it. A few thin arrows can indicate movement, no huge effects.
